description: ECDAT Mosca Theorem Configuration (X + Y > Z risk calculus)

extended_2035.description: Optimistic quantum timeline: CRQC deployment delayed to ~2041; rapid standards and tooling maturity.

baseline_2033.description: Consensus baseline timeline: CRQC deployment ~2035 (consistent with CNSA 2.0 and BSI roadmaps).

conservative_2030.description: Aggressive/Nation-state timeline: CRQC operational ~2031; slower migration velocity and legacy inertia.

network_session.notes: Transient network traffic; subject to Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later (HNDL) if intercepted and stored.

certificate.notes: Public trust and mTLS certificates; signature forgery on expired certs is non-viable, but active cert spoofing is critical once CRQC is reached.

hardcoded_private_key.notes: Statically embedded keys persist across deployments, enabling retrospective decryption of historical data.

stored_encrypted_data.notes: Encrypted database columns, backups, or archival vaults; extreme HNDL exposure requiring immediate PQC / hybrid envelope protection.

signing_key.notes: Code signing, document signing, and root CA keys; requires long-term non-repudiation and firmware integrity.

library_presence.notes: Identified crypto library package; presence indicates capability rather than confirmed active ciphertext.

public.description: Public data requires no confidentiality shelf-life (X = 0).

internal.description: Standard operational/internal business data (typical shelf-life 3 years).

confidential.description: Proprietary business secrets, PII, intellectual property (shelf-life 7 years).

restricted.description: State secrets, classified intelligence, clinical records, core financial ledgers (shelf-life 15+ years).

low.description: Non-essential testing/development systems; lower operational impact.

medium.description: Standard business applications with moderate downtime tolerance.

high.description: Core enterprise infrastructure, payment gateways, and production APIs.

critical.description: National critical infrastructure, safety-critical systems, or identity foundations.
